select
from gc_video v
LEFT JOIN gc_subject s ON s.id=v.sub_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_access_permission uap on uap.sub_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(s.fid::integer) LEFT JOIN gc_user_access ua on ua.id=uap.user_access_id
ua.master_id=#{masterId} and v.video_name like '%${videoName}%' and ua.user_id=#{userId}

select
,f2.thumb_nail_url as thumb_nail_url from gc_video v
left join sys_file f2 on f2.id = f.thumb_nail_id LEFT JOIN gc_subject s ON s.id=v.sub_id
m.id=#{masterId} and v.video_name like '%${videoName}%'

select
,f.target_lang_json as target_lang_json, s.fid as subId0, s.name as topicName from gc_video v
left join gc_subject s on s.id = v.sub_id where v.id=#{id} order by v."order"

select
,s.name as topicName, s0.name as subjectName, f.thumb_nail_url as thumb_nail_url from gc_video v
LEFT JOIN gc_subject s ON s.id=v.sub_id LEFT JOIN gc_subject s0 ON s0.id=s.fid
where uva.user_id=#{userId} and s.master_id = #{masterId} and uva.type =1
order by uva.create_time desc

select
,f.thumb_nail_url as thumb_nail_url,s.fid as subId0 from gc_video v
left join gc_subject s on s.id = v.sub_id where v.sub_id in
#{subId}
order by v."order",v.create_time asc,v.id

SELECT
, S."fid" AS subId0 ,s.id as sub_id FROM GC_SUBJECT S LEFT JOIN GC_VIDEO V ON S.ID = V.SUB_ID
WHERE S.FID IN
#{subId}
and v.id is not null order by v.order,v.create_time asc,v.id

SELECT
, S."fid" AS subId0 ,s.id as sub_id, count(r.id) as resourceNum FROM GC_VIDEO v LEFT JOIN gc_subject s ON S.ID = V.SUB_ID left join gc_resource r on r.video_id = v.id
WHERE v.sub_id IN
#{subId}
and v.id is not null GROUP BY v.id, f.id, S."fid", s.id order by v.order asc,v.create_time asc,v.id

SELECT
, S."fid" AS subId0 ,s.id as sub_id FROM GC_SUBJECT S LEFT JOIN GC_VIDEO V ON S.ID = V.SUB_ID
WHERE S.FID IN
#{subId}

select
, S."fid" AS subId0 from gc_video v
LEFT JOIN GC_SUBJECT S ON S.ID = V.SUB_ID where S.FID IN
#{subId}
and v.video_name like concat('%',#{videoName},'%')
order by v.order asc,v.create_time asc,v.id

select
,round(avg(star_value)::numeric,2) as starvalue, v.order from gc_video v
left join gc_user_video_action ac on ac.content_id = v.id where v.sub_id=#{subId} group by v.id, f.id order by v."order" asc,v.create_time asc,v.id

select
,s.sub_id as top_sub_id,s.fid as subId0, file.id as f_id,file.name as f_name,file.folder as f_folder,file.file_url as f_file_url, file.file_type as f_file_type,file.file_type_index as f_file_type_index,file.master_id as f_master_id, file.save_type as f_save_type from gc_video v LEFT JOIN gc_subject s ON s.id=v.sub_id LEFT JOIN sys_file file on file.id = v.file_id WHERE 1=1
AND s.id in
#{subId}
order by v.order asc,v.create_time asc,v.id

select
,s.sub_id as top_sub_id,s.fid as subId0, file.id as f_id,file.name as f_name,file.folder as f_folder,file.file_url as f_file_url, file.file_type as f_file_type,file.file_type_index as f_file_type_index,file.master_id as f_master_id, file.save_type as f_save_type from gc_video v LEFT JOIN gc_subject s ON s.id=v.sub_id LEFT JOIN sys_file file on file.id = v.file_id left join gc_event event on event.video_id = v.id WHERE 1=1
AND s.sub_id in
#{subId}
order by v.order asc,v.create_time asc,v.id

#{vid}

SELECT
, s2."fid" AS subId0 ,s2.id as sub_id, ap.id as permission_id from GC_SUBJECT s left join gc_user_access_permission ap on ap.sub_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(s.id::integer) left join gc_subject s2 on s2.fid = s.id LEFT JOIN GC_VIDEO V ON S2.ID = V.SUB_ID
where ap.id in
#{accessPermissionId}
and v.id is not null

select
,COALESCE(v.video_name,f.name) as video_name, v."order" as "order" from gc_video v right join sys_file f on v.file_id=f.id where 1=2
or ( v.id in
#{videoList} )
or( f.id in
#{fileList}
)
order by v."order"

select max(p.play_state) as play_state,v.id as id from gc_subject s left join gc_subject s2 on s2.fid = s.id left join gc_video v on v.sub_id = s2.id left join gc_user_video_play p on p.video_id = v.id and user_id = #{userId} where s.id = #{subId} and v.id is not null GROUP BY v.id
SELECT max( p.play_state ) AS play_state, v.id AS id FROM gc_video v LEFT JOIN gc_user_video_play p ON p.video_id = v.id AND user_id = #{userId} WHERE v.id = #{video} GROUP BY v.id

select id from gc_video where sub_id in
#{subIds}

SELECT
, pc.id AS channel_id, pc.channel_name AS channel_channel_name, pc.channel_slug AS channel_channel_slug, pcc.id AS channel_channel_content_id, channel_owner.id AS channel_create_user_id, channel_owner_info.first_name AS channel_create_user_first_name, channel_owner_info.last_name AS channel_create_user_last_name, channel_owner_avatar.file_url AS channel_create_user_avatar_full_file_url, gs.id AS course_id, gs.name AS course_name, course_owner.id AS course_user_info_id, course_owner_info.first_name AS course_user_info_first_name, course_owner_info.last_name AS course_user_info_last_name, course_owner_avatar.file_url AS course_user_info_avatar_full_file_url FROM gc_video v JOIN sys_file f ON v.file_id = f.id
LEFT JOIN pt_channel pc ON v.origin_channel_id = pc.id LEFT JOIN pt_channel_content pcc ON pcc.content_id = v.id LEFT JOIN gc_user channel_owner ON pc.create_user_id = channel_owner.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info channel_owner_info ON channel_owner.info_id = channel_owner_info.id LEFT JOIN sys_file channel_owner_avatar ON channel_owner_info.avatar_file_id = channel_owner_avatar.id
LEFT JOIN gc_subject gs ON v.origin_course_id = gs.id LEFT JOIN gc_user course_owner ON gs.create_user = course_owner.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info course_owner_info ON course_owner.info_id = course_owner_info.id LEFT JOIN sys_file course_owner_avatar ON course_owner_info.avatar_file_id = course_owner_avatar.id WHERE ((gs.master_id = #{masterId} AND gs.state = 1 AND course_owner.id IS NOT NULL) OR (pc.master_id = #{masterId} AND pc.visible_flag != 0 AND channel_owner.id IS NOT NULL))
AND v.video_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.query}, '%')
ORDER BY v.create_time DESC

SELECT
, pc.id AS channel_id, pc.channel_name AS channel_channel_name, pc.channel_slug AS channel_channel_slug, pcc.id AS channel_channel_content_id, channel_owner.id AS channel_create_user_id, channel_owner_info.first_name AS channel_create_user_first_name, channel_owner_info.last_name AS channel_create_user_last_name, channel_owner_avatar.file_url AS channel_create_user_avatar_full_file_url, gs.id AS course_id, gs.name AS course_name, course_owner.id AS course_user_info_id, course_owner_info.first_name AS course_user_info_first_name, course_owner_info.last_name AS course_user_info_last_name, course_owner_avatar.file_url AS course_user_info_avatar_full_file_url FROM gc_video v JOIN sys_file f ON v.file_id = f.id
LEFT JOIN pt_channel pc ON v.origin_channel_id = pc.id LEFT JOIN pt_channel_content pcc ON pcc.content_id = v.id LEFT JOIN gc_user channel_owner ON pc.create_user_id = channel_owner.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info channel_owner_info ON channel_owner.info_id = channel_owner_info.id LEFT JOIN sys_file channel_owner_avatar ON channel_owner_info.avatar_file_id = channel_owner_avatar.id
LEFT JOIN gc_subject gs ON v.origin_course_id = gs.id LEFT JOIN gc_user course_owner ON gs.create_user = course_owner.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info course_owner_info ON course_owner.info_id = course_owner_info.id LEFT JOIN sys_file course_owner_avatar ON course_owner_info.avatar_file_id = course_owner_avatar.id WHERE v.file_id = #{fileId}
